shortDescription: Information module for Health Score Definitions

options.name: attribute
options.description: Attribute query parameter. These are the attributes supported in health score definitions response. By default, all properties are sent in response.

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: deviceType
options.description: DeviceType query parameter. These are the device families supported for health score definitions. If no input is made on device family, all device families are considered.

options.name: id
options.description: Id query parameter. The definition identifier. Examples id=015d9cba-4f53-4087-8317-7e49e5ffef46 (single entity id request) id=015d9cba-4f53-4087-8317-7e49e5ffef46&id=015d9cba-4f53-4087-8317-7e49e5ffef47 (multiple ids in the query param).

options.name: includeForOverallHealth
options.description: IncludeForOverallHealth query parameter. The inclusion status of the issue definition, either true or false. True indicates that particular health metric is included in overall health computation, otherwise false. By default it's set to true.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Maximum number of records to return.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Specifies the starting point within all records returned by the API. It's one based offset. The starting value is 1.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
